title: Understanding useState
body: useState is a React Hook that allows functional components to have state. It returns a state value and a function to update it. When the state changes, React re-renders the component.

title: What is JSX
body: JSX is a syntax extension for JavaScript that looks similar to HTML. It is used in React to describe what the UI should look like. JSX gets compiled into regular JavaScript.

title: Components in React
body: Components are the building blocks of a React application. They can be functional or class-based. Each component can manage its own state and receive data through props.

title: Handling Events
body: React allows you to handle user interactions like clicks, inputs, and form submissions using event handlers. These handlers are usually functions passed to elements like onClick or onChange.

title: Conditional Rendering
body: Conditional rendering in React allows you to display different UI elements based on certain conditions. You can use if statements, ternary operators, or logical AND operators.
